## BITE WOUNDS WITH EIKENELLA CORRODENS
## Treatment
## Inpatient

Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875-125 mg PO q12h ($) [R] < OR >
Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q6h ($$) [R]
## Alternative for penicillin allergy
Doxycycline 100MG PO Q12H
References:
Stevens DL Clin Infect Dis 2014, 59:147
Sanford keyword: Bites
Mandell chapter: Cellulitis and subcutaneous tissue infections ## Outpatient

## Treatment for infection without joint involvement
## __________________________________________________
Treat for 10 days.
Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID ($) [R]
Non-VA order for above
## Alternative for penicillin allergy
Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID ($) [DI]
Non-VA order for above
